title: Land of Ooo from Adventure Time
author: Fingerstache_Jaden

title.es: Tierra de Ooo de Hora de Aventura
title.pt: Terra de Ooo de Hora de Aventura
title.de: Land of Ooo aus Adventure Time

generated.description: A large, blocky recreation of the Land of Ooo from the cartoon Adventure Time, built mostly from oak logs, dirt, grass and oak leaves, with birch, spruce and terracotta accents and a gold block detail. It is about 94 wide, 76 high and 83 deep, with a mountainous landscape, trees and a few interior-style pieces such as chests, an enchanting table, furnaces and a record player.
